title: 7d98(ii): wire tunnel egress check into a Python gateway data path (needs gateway assembly)
description: Parent: project-LICHEN-worker6-7d98. BLOCKED on design: no Python gateway forwarding path exists (gateway binaries are C/Zephyr + Rust; Python lichen/gateway/* are libraries). When a Python gateway assembly exists (or the simulator gains an egress node): call TunnelEgressGateway.forward / TunnelAuthorizationTable.authorize_decapsulation at the mesh-to-external boundary with the route from the Source-Route Header, drop unauthorized per spec/06 727-807. Do not invent the assembly inside this child; coordinate with whoever builds the Python gateway entry point.
